featured_reviews.name: Srinivas Rayudu
featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional Service – Fast, Genuine & Reliable!
I recently placed an order with Bulkprintouts for a 255-page Study Guide with spiral binding. From the very first message, the experience was smooth and professional.

What truly stood out was their speed and transparency — they confirmed the job, shared a photo of the finished book the same evening, and dispatched it promptly. The print quality is excellent and the spiral binding is neat and sturdy.

If you're looking for a trustworthy printing service that delivers what they promise, Bulkprintouts is the one! Highly recommended for students and professionals alike. Will definitely order again! 🙌📚

featured_reviews.name: Amrutha Mariya George
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely the cheapest and best printing service I’ve come across. I got 3181 pages printed as 7 books with spiral binding, and there was no compromise on quality at all.
What impressed me the most was the delivery — from Mumbai to Wayanad, Kerala in just 8 days! The packaging was very secure, everything arrived in perfect condition.
Excellent customer service, very responsive and professional throughout the process. Highly recommended for anyone looking for affordable, high-quality printing with reliable delivery.
One of the cheapest printing services available. They charged just 50 paise per sheet (both sides) for black & white printing, plus courier charges based on weight — and even then, it turned out to be the most affordable option.

featured_reviews.name: Akhin Vp
featured_reviews.review_text: Exceptional. They are fast, prompt, honest and trustworthy. On time. To my surprise they couriered the product even without payment. I paid today and after 1 hr the courier person knocked my door. That too I am at Chennai. I shall go with them more number of times. Thank you.

featured_reviews.name: Ambar Chattaraj
featured_reviews.review_text: Hands down the cheapest rates for print I have come across in Mumbai. They are pretty quick too, got 903 pages printed and spiral binding done in less than an hour. Since it was the ocassion of Holi, and courier shipping would have taken 4-5 days, I got the things printed and then used Porter for delivery to my place in Navi Mumbai. The print and spiral charges were 700, 200 needed to be paid in advance, and the rest when the job is complete. I was charged 611 by Porter for the delivery. From the next time I would pre-plan my orders.

featured_reviews.name: Jesus Christ
featured_reviews.review_text: Never seen such a gentleman in the business nd never seen such a quality. So fast completion. 768 pages within an hour and shipped same hour. Very intelligent person nd so good quality. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Ghatge
featured_reviews.review_text: The perfect shop for printing. I placed my order yesterday at around 1pm and asked for a delivery by 4:00-4:30 pm. I reached their shop by 4:00 pm and they had already kept the books ready for dispatch. Total: 2100 Pages were done for just INR 1275 including the spiral binding!! Out of this, only INR 500 were taken as advance- which is very accommodating for first timer's! The owner and the helpers are really polite. A fuss free solution for printing in Mumbai. Quality is just too good! You can rely on them for any printing requirements. They also courier the package at an additional cost (applicable as per distance and weight).

featured_reviews.name: angelina
featured_reviews.review_text: Got my PDFs (approx 812 pages) at such a cheap price, the printouts were flawless and of good quality, also the staple binding was free too others were charging for it too, but really loved it!!! Thank you so much, bulkprintouts will order more from here. Since I'm a student studying for competitive exam and have to get printouts of study material and printouts at such a cheap rate is litr a god's work in this economy. The delivery was so quick litr got it the next day itself (mumbai resident). But their delivery is very fast if you're in Mumbai, no doubt js go for it guys!!!!

featured_reviews.review_text: I had one of the most miserable experience with Royal Printers. When i fired the person (lal) did he initiate my visiting card delivery which i received at 10:30 in the night (a few hours before my event). And to my worst nightmare the sample approved by me was not even the one printed on my visiting card. Basically a wrong design and color combination was printed and handed out to me. Even after informing them about the error these guys didn't make any initiative to rectify the mistake nor apologized for it. The most ridiculous service i have ever received. Recommend that no one shud use royal printer for their printing needs!
